map.留针时间(按病症)推荐器 使用指南: Needle retention time (by condition) recommender guide
map.留针时间推荐器，依据病症性质(虚/实/寒/热)与患者情况推荐留针时长，以守气、候: The needle retention time recommender suggests retention duration based on the nature of the condition (deficiency/excess/cold/heat) and patient status, aiming to preserve, await and regulate qi for a better needling effect.
map.虚证、寒证留针久以候气（30–40 分）。: Deficiency and cold patterns retain needles longer to await qi (30-40 min).
map.实证、热证留针短（10–20 分）。: Excess and heat patterns retain needles only briefly (10-20 min).
map.急性痛证留针期间间歇行针。: For acute pain, manipulate the needle intermittently during retention.
